skill.summary: Health Reasoner — 日常习惯健康小工具。基于生活习惯（睡眠/饮食/运动/压力/烟酒）输出评分与改善建议。纯规则驱动，纯 Python 标准库。不提供医疗诊断。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Description and documentation clarified: now explicitly states non-medical, non-diagnostic purpose.
- Scope narrowed: symptom and medical history fields removed.
- Interface simplified: focuses on lifestyle habits only (sleep, diet, exercise, stress, smoking, alcohol).
- Feature set trimmed: risk evaluation and trending features no longer documented.
- Quick Start and feature list updated to reflect new, simpler usage.
- Emphasis on rule transparency and zero external dependencies maintained.
